opportunities.name: Blight cooldown circuit
opportunities.objective: Use three-stack detonation to reopen basic spells while preserving attack access.
opportunities.mechanic: W supplies AP/AD magic on-hit, three Blight stacks and maximum-cooldown reductions per detonation stack against champions/epic monsters. Nashor and Dusk test attack-to-detonation cycling; R gradually grants three stacks while Q charge amplifies detonation. AP supports both on-hit and percent-health damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Three actual stacks before detonation, target eligible for cooldown refund and Q charge recorded.
opportunities.failure: Charging while exposed prevents attacks or detonating early forfeits health damage and refund.
opportunities.test: Log stacks, Q charge and basic cooldown remaining after one versus three-stack detonations.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Dusk repeat does not establish two Blight stacks from one attack.

opportunities.name: Root volley magic
opportunities.objective: Use R's root to apply Fiendhunter's finite attacks before a charged W-Q finish.
opportunities.mechanic: R roots and applies Blight over its duration; Fiendhunter grants three enhanced basic attacks after R. Statikk offers AD/AP and attack effects; W's missing-health active rewards delaying Q until health falls. Terminus provides mixed penetration only after confirmed attack ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: R lands, three attacks available inside item window and W active held for charged Q.
opportunities.failure: Overlapping R and attack stacks waste the cap or target dies/escapes before Q charge.
opportunities.test: Compare R-three attacks-WQ versus R-WQ, counting capped stacks and all attack/item packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Passive's raw Stat(4) formula cannot be assumed to grant a fixed AP/AD amount.

ruledOut.reason: Passive Blight detonation is max-health damage; W active adds a distinct missing-health Q packet.

unknowns: Passive Stat(4), W phantom-hit stacking and exact charge multiplier ordering need in-game verification.

builds.name: Blight cooldown circuit
builds.summary: Use three-stack detonation to reopen basic spells while preserving attack access.
builds.goal: Use three-stack detonation to reopen basic spells while preserving attack access.
builds.hypothesis: W supplies AP/AD magic on-hit, three Blight stacks and maximum-cooldown reductions per detonation stack against champions/epic monsters. Nashor and Dusk test attack-to-detonation cycling; R gradually grants three stacks while Q charge amplifies detonation. AP supports both on-hit and percent-health damage.
testPlan: Required state: Three actual stacks before detonation, target eligible for cooldown refund and Q charge recorded.
Log stacks, Q charge and basic cooldown remaining after one versus three-stack detonations.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Charging while exposed prevents attacks or detonating early forfeits health damage and refund.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Dusk repeat does not establish two Blight stacks from one attack.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Cosmic Drive, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
